Generated code compilation/loading error:
cuModuleLoadDataEx failed: CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_PTX: a PTX JIT compilation failed
PTX JIT error log:
ptxas application ptx input, line 13; fatal   : Parsing error near '.param': syntax error
ptxas fatal   : Ptx assembly aborted due to errors
Loading ModelNew failed: ModelNew is None
fix:
<reasoning>
The JIT failure is a pure PTX syntax error at the kernel parameter list: line 16 (`.param .u32 _inw`) is missing the trailing comma before `.param .u32 _outc` on line 17. Adding the comma fixes the reported `ptxas` parse error at line 13 of the PTX input.

After that fix, `ptxas` would next fail on the duplicated label `WT_DONE:` at source lines 71 and 72 — PTX labels must be unique, so one of the two duplicate label lines must be deleted. The double `ret;` at the end is unreachable-but-legal, so I leave it untouched to avoid changing intent. Everything else (shared memory staging, FMA contraction, epilogue, launch configuration) stays exactly as written.
</reasoning>

```json
[
  {
    "action": "replace",
    "line_number": 16,
    "new_code": "    .param .u32 _inw,"
  },
  {
    "action": "delete",
    "line_number": 72,
    "num_lines": 1
  }
]
```
